info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Vanadat Laptop Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Laptop Details Catalog API enables the addition of detailed information about Vanadat laptop models to a centralized catalog. This API allows businesses to enhance their product offerings by including specifications, features, and pricing details relevant to each laptop model. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems that rely on accurate and comprehensive product information. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline catalog updates and ensure consistency across sales channels.

post.summary: Create details for a Vanadat Laptop
post.description: This operation allows you to create detailed information for a Vanadat Laptop, which can be used for various management and inventory purposes. Ensure that you provide all required information in the request body to successfully create the details.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the details to be submitted for the vanadat laptop. Ensure that the data adheres to the specified schema.

200.description: The request was completed successfully, and the laptop details are returned.
